title: Targeting SOX9: designing a novel vaccine against triple-negative breast cancer.
authors: Hatamian, Ghazaleh; Ebrahimpour, Amirali; Nejabat, Mojgan; Hadizadeh, Farzin
one_liner_zh: 该文用免疫信息学设计靶向SOX9转录因子的多表位疫苗，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作对象SOX9，但核心是疫苗免疫原性预测与TLR受体对接，非TF-DNA结合机制研究，方法上仅用免疫信息学与分子对接，与课题聚焦的TF-DNA互作建模关联较弱。
abstract: Triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is a highly aggressive breast cancer subtype that lacks targeted therapies. This study aimed to design a novel multi-epitope peptide vaccine targeting SOX9, a transcription factor associated with TNBC progression. Using an immunoinformatic approach, B-cell, helper T lymphocyte (HTL), and cytotoxic T lymphocyte (CTL) epitopes with high antigenicity, non-toxicity, and non-allergenicity were identified. These epitopes were linked with appropriate spacers and fused to the 50 S ribosomal protein L7/L12 adjuvant to construct the vaccine. Physicochemical analysis predicted the construct to be stable, soluble, and suitable for expression. Structural modeling and refinement confirmed its quality, while molecular docking and dynamics simulations demonstrated favorable interactions with TLR2 and TLR4 receptors. Immune simulations predicted the strong cellular and humoral immune responses. These findings suggest that the designed vaccine holds substantial promise as a candidate for TNBC immunotherapy and merits further experimental validation.
abstract_zh: 三阴性乳腺癌（TNBC）是一种高度侵袭性的乳腺癌亚型，目前缺乏靶向治疗手段。本研究旨在设计一种针对SOX9（一种与TNBC进展相关的转录因子）的新型多表位肽疫苗。采用免疫信息学方法，鉴定了具有高抗原性、无毒性和非过敏性的B细胞、辅助性T淋巴细胞（HTL）和细胞毒性T淋巴细胞（CTL）表位。这些表位通过适当的间隔序列连接，并融合至50S核糖体蛋白L7/L12佐剂以构建疫苗。理化性质分析预测该构建体稳定、可溶且适合表达。结构建模与优化确认了其质量，而分子对接和动力学模拟表明其与TLR2和TLR4受体具有良好的相互作用。免疫模拟预测了强烈的细胞和体液免疫反应。这些发现表明，所设计的疫苗作为TNBC免疫治疗的候选方案具有显著潜力，值得进一步的实验验证。
